text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year!
Lookin' forward to workin' with ya this year too, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: New Year's Day. Hishi Amazon came by the Trainer's office to give her New Year's greetings.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And with that, here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon began taking out rice cakes one after another
and lining them up on the desk.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Here's ankoromochi and yomogi mochi—this one has brown sugar, so be careful not to make a mess when you eat it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And here's regular sliced mochi, plus a kagami mochi!
I even brought a mandarin orange with leaves attached!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I swallow the urge to point out that kagami mochi usually uses a bitter orange instead of a mandarin...
and accept it gratefully.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An all-inclusive New Year's mochi set.
Such meticulous thoughtfulness is so very like Hishi Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, right? We gathered the girls who weren't going home
and made 'em at the Miho Dorm's New Year's mochi-pounding party.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
When I said I was gonna put a kagami mochi in the Trainer's office,
she got all fired up and pounded the mochi for me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
To set a good example for those kids,
this year has gotta be the year of big sis Hishi Ama!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We need to finalize
this year's rotation soon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I asked Hishi Amazon which she preferred, the Tiara route or the Triple Crown route—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Oh, right!
Come to think of it, race routes and all that were a thing, weren't they?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Ah, my bad. All I had on my mind
was having a one-on-one duel!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The Tiara route or the Triple Crown route...
Hmm, what a tough choice...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I feel like the Kikuka Sho
might be a bit too long for me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Besides, if I remember correctly, Nakayama Racecourse has a short final stretch with a steep hill...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Which means Hanshin might actually suit me better since I specialize in late charges.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, our first target is the Oka Sho—
All right, let's tear up the Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"No, wait! Isn't Brian definitely aiming
for the Triple Crown route?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She's been called the “top contender for the Triple Crown,”
plus she's really good at long distances, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"If it's the Triple Crown route,
can I go toe-to-toe with Brian starting this year...?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sheesh!
What am I supposed to do?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because her enthusiasm for this year is so strong,
she is uncharacteristically hesitating.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might be best to take a break for a change of pace
and rethink things from scratch.
choice_data_list: Want to try making some udon?
Let's take it easy for a bit.
Let's play some New Year's games!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Udon~?
What's this, tryna give me a change of pace or somethin'?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Why not? That sounds great!
Doing that is pretty refreshing, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We've got ingredients back at the dorm too, right?
I'll go grab them real quick, so hang tight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, an impromptu udon-making session began—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Kh! Not yet, not yet, not yeet!
At this rate, I'll turn into limp, soggy udon!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"We're aiming for smooth and chewy udon!
Deyaaaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, udon with an exceptionally firm, chewy texture was made.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: S-Slowly?! But—
choice_data_list: Let's try to calm down a bit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, I know that, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"No... Come to think of it, I say the same thing
when I'm trying to calm down the girls from Miho."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped, got it!
Guess I'll try emptying my mind for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
............
Nice weather, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Sitting still like this
makes me kind of sleepy..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we spent that day
just relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what's with you all of a sudden! Telling me to calm down?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, you've got a point.
Time to stop overthinking and just drop it!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Let's play, Trainy! I actually quite like
Japanese New Year's games. I've played 'em before, you know."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Spinning tops? Kite flying? Fukuwarai?
A board game like Sugoroku sounds fun too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wha! A 1 again?! I'm the only one
not making any progress at all, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...No, the real show starts now!
Next roll is definitely a 6, I believe in—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle rattle...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: One!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we spent the rest of that day
relaxing and having fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We decided to discuss this year's race rotation
on another day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All in all, a brand-new year
with Hishi Amazon had begun!
